## Points for the author
1. C81 merges C4 (goals and processes, F15;F17;F18) with C18 (goals only, F15). The SS Results report only the goals part; the alternative is to keep C18 apart as a narrower claim (fit expand) covered by C81.
2. C23 (attendance and participation varied, "with evidence of status hierarchies and medical dominance", SS p.xxvii) and C59 (medical dominance, SS key findings and Ch.7) were not merged: C23's main assertion is variation. A rule-1 split of C23 would make its dominance part a repeat of C59.
3. Not merged as different scope: C57 vs C84 (different domains, technology added), C39 vs C52 (C52 adds the 21 indications), C56 vs C83 (C83 adds the causal link).
